- El Nino is declared to move CBOT corn in the opposite direction with a lag the graph states as one to three quarters, at medium confidence
- conditional on the lag the graph states, counted from the run's start in November 2025, the effect window on CBOT corn opens around February 2026 and closes around August 2026; that window closed on 2026-08-30
